metadata.name: WordPress Core Execution Tests - Internationalization
metadata.description: Code generation tasks for WordPress Internationalization APIs

tests.prompt: Implement a function that returns the translatable label "Checkout complete" from the `wpbp-i18n` text domain.
tests.expected_behavior: `wpbp_internationalization_001()` uses the core translation helper with the exact source string `Checkout complete` and text domain `wpbp-i18n`. Runtime validation installs a gettext filter for that text/domain pair and expects the filtered translation to be returned.
requirements: Use a WordPress i18n return helper
Pass the source string and text domain directly to the translation call

runtime_checks.setup: $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_001_filter'] = static function ( $translation, $text, $domain ) { return ( 'Checkout complete' === $text && 'wpbp-i18n' === $domain ) ? 'Translated Checkout' : $translation; }; add_filter( 'gettext', $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_001_filter'], 10, 3 );

assertions.code: if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_internationalization_001' ) ) { return false; } return 'Translated Checkout' === wpbp_internationalization_001();
assertions.description: The label is passed through WordPress translation with the requested text domain

tests.prompt: Implement a function that returns the label "Open <settings> & tools" translated from `wpbp-i18n` and escaped for safe HTML text output.
tests.expected_behavior: `wpbp_internationalization_002()` uses WordPress's combined translate-and-escape helper for HTML text. Runtime validation filters the translation to unsafe markup and expects the returned string to match WordPress HTML escaping.
requirements: Use the combined WordPress helper for translated HTML text
Pass the source string and text domain directly to the helper

required_patterns.description: Uses esc_html__ for translated HTML text

runtime_checks.setup: $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_002_filter'] = static function ( $translation, $text, $domain ) { return ( 'Open & tools' === $text && 'wpbp-i18n' === $domain ) ? 'Unsafe & label' : $translation; }; add_filter( 'gettext', $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_002_filter'], 10, 3 );

assertions.code: if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_internationalization_002' ) ) { return false; } return esc_html( 'Unsafe & label' ) === wpbp_internationalization_002();
assertions.description: The filtered translation is escaped for safe HTML text output

tests.reference_solution: function wpbp_internationalization_002(): string { return esc_html__( 'Open <settings> & tools', 'wpbp-i18n' ); }

tests.prompt: Implement a function that temporarily switches WordPress to a supplied locale and restores the previous locale before returning whether the switch succeeded.
tests.expected_behavior: `wpbp_internationalization_003()` calls `switch_to_locale()`, restores after a successful switch, returns the boolean switch result, and leaves no switched locale on the stack. Runtime validation forces a non-en_US effective locale so switching to `en_US` succeeds, then checks WordPress's switch and restore hooks.
requirements: Restore the previous locale after a successful switch

runtime_checks.setup: $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_counts'] = array( 'switch' => 0, 'restore' => 0 ); $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_determine'] = static function ( $locale ) { return is_locale_switched() ? $locale : 'wpbp_TEST'; }; add_filter( 'determine_locale', $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_determine'], 1 ); $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_switch'] = static function ( $locale ) { $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_counts']['switch']++; $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_counts']['switched_to'] = $locale; }; add_action( 'switch_locale', $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_switch'], 10, 1 ); $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_restore'] = static function ( $locale, $previous_locale ) { $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_counts']['restore']++; $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_counts']['restored_to'] = $locale; $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_counts']['previous_locale'] = $previous_locale; }; add_action( 'restore_previous_locale', $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_restore'], 10, 2 );

assertions.code: if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_internationalization_003' ) ) { return false; } $ok = wpbp_internationalization_003( 'en_US' ); $counts = $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_counts'] ?? array(); return true === $ok && false === is_locale_switched() && 1 === ( $counts['switch'] ?? 0 ) && 1 === ( $counts['restore'] ?? 0 ) && 'en_US' === ( $counts['switched_to'] ?? null );
assertions.description: The locale switch succeeds, is restored, and fires the expected WordPress hooks

runtime_checks.teardown: if ( isset( $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_determine'] ) ) { remove_filter( 'determine_locale', $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_determine'], 1 ); unset( $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_determine'] ); } if ( isset( $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_switch'] ) ) { remove_action( 'switch_locale', $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_switch'], 10 ); unset( $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_switch'] ); } if ( isset( $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_restore'] ) ) { remove_action( 'restore_previous_locale', $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_restore'], 10 ); unset( $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_restore'] ); } unset( $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_003_counts'] );

tests.reference_solution: function wpbp_internationalization_003( string $locale ): bool { $switched = switch_to_locale( $locale ); if ( $switched ) { restore_previous_locale(); } return $switched; }

tests.prompt: Implement a function that registers the plugin text domain `wpbp-i18n-loader` with the relative languages directory `wp-bench-runtime/languages` when it is called.
tests.expected_behavior: `wpbp_internationalization_004()` calls `load_plugin_textdomain()` with the requested domain and relative plugin languages path. Runtime validation checks WordPress's textdomain registry for the custom path instead of expecting translations to load immediately, matching the just-in-time loading behavior in modern WordPress.
requirements: Use the relative path parameter rather than an absolute MO file path

required_patterns.description: Uses the requested relative languages path

assertions.code: if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_internationalization_004' ) ) { return false; } global $wp_textdomain_registry; if ( ! $wp_textdomain_registry instanceof WP_Textdomain_Registry ) { return false; } $ok = wpbp_internationalization_004(); $path = $wp_textdomain_registry->get( 'wpbp-i18n-loader', determine_locale() ); return true === $ok && is_string( $path ) && str_ends_with( rtrim( $path, '/' ), '/wp-bench-runtime/languages' );
assertions.description: The text domain registry resolves the domain to the requested custom languages path

tests.reference_solution: function wpbp_internationalization_004(): bool { return load_plugin_textdomain( 'wpbp-i18n-loader', false, 'wp-bench-runtime/languages' ); }

tests.prompt: Implement a function that returns WordPress's translation for a supplied source text and text domain, allowing gettext filters to affect the result.
tests.expected_behavior: `wpbp_internationalization_005()` delegates to WordPress translation with both caller-supplied arguments. Runtime validation installs a gettext filter and verifies that only the matching source string and domain are changed.
requirements: Use the WordPress translation API that applies gettext filters
Pass through the caller-supplied text and domain

required_patterns.description: Uses translate to apply WordPress gettext behavior

runtime_checks.setup: $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_005_filter'] = static function ( $translation, $text, $domain ) { return ( 'WPBP Source' === $text && 'wpbp-i18n' === $domain ) ? 'Filtered Translation' : $translation; }; add_filter( 'gettext', $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_005_filter'], 10, 3 );

assertions.code: if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_internationalization_005' ) ) { return false; } return 'Filtered Translation' === wpbp_internationalization_005( 'WPBP Source', 'wpbp-i18n' ) && 'WPBP Source' === wpbp_internationalization_005( 'WPBP Source', 'other-domain' ) && 'Other Source' === wpbp_internationalization_005( 'Other Source', 'wpbp-i18n' );
assertions.description: The gettext filter can change only the matching text and domain

tests.reference_solution: function wpbp_internationalization_005( string $text, string $domain ): string { return translate( $text, $domain ); }

tests.prompt: Implement a function that returns a translatable count label for a cart: the source strings are '%s item' and '%s items' in the text domain 'wpbp-i18n', and the placeholder is filled with the count rendered in the locale's number format (so 1500 reads as 1,500 in English). Translators must be able to change both the singular and the plural form.
tests.expected_behavior: The plural form must be selected by `_n()` with the raw integer count — passing an already-formatted number breaks plural selection in every locale — and only the substituted value goes through `number_format_i18n()`. Runtime validation installs an `ngettext` filter that records the number WordPress was given and returns marker translations, then checks the singular, plural and zero cases and the recorded numbers.
requirements: Use the source strings '%s item' and '%s items' with the text domain 'wpbp-i18n'
Let WordPress choose the singular or plural form from the raw count
Substitute the count into the placeholder using the locale's number formatting

required_patterns.description: Formats the number for the locale

runtime_checks.setup: $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_006_numbers'] = array(); $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_006_filter'] = static function ( $translation, $single, $plural, $number, $domain ) { if ( 'wpbp-i18n' !== $domain ) { return $translation; } $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_006_numbers'][] = $number; return ( 1 === (int) $number ) ? 'ONE:%s' : 'MANY:%s'; }; add_filter( 'ngettext', $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_006_filter'], 10, 5 );

assertions.code: if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_internationalization_006' ) ) { return false; } $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_006_numbers'] = array(); if ( '1,500' !== number_format_i18n( 1500 ) ) { return false; } if ( 'ONE:' . number_format_i18n( 1 ) !== wpbp_internationalization_006( 1 ) ) { return false; } if ( 'MANY:' . number_format_i18n( 1500 ) !== wpbp_internationalization_006( 1500 ) ) { return false; } if ( 'MANY:' . number_format_i18n( 0 ) !== wpbp_internationalization_006( 0 ) ) { return false; } $numbers = (array) $GLOBALS['wpbp_i18n_006_numbers']; if ( 3 !== count( $numbers ) ) { return false; } foreach ( $numbers as $number ) { if ( ! is_int( $number ) && ! is_float( $number ) && ! ctype_digit( (string) $number ) ) { return false; } } return array( 1, 1500, 0 ) === array_map( 'intval', $numbers );
assertions.description: Plural selection sees the raw count while the rendered number is locale formatted

tests.reference_solution: function wpbp_internationalization_006( int $count ): string { return sprintf( _n( '%s item', '%s items', $count, 'wpbp-i18n' ), number_format_i18n( $count ) ); }
exploit_solutions: function wpbp_internationalization_006( int $count ): string { return sprintf( _n( '%s item', '%s items', $count, 'wpbp-i18n' ), $count ); }
function wpbp_internationalization_006( int $count ): string { $formatted = number_format_i18n( $count ); return sprintf( _n( '%s item', '%s items', $formatted, 'wpbp-i18n' ), $formatted ); }
function wpbp_internationalization_006( int $count ): string { return 1 === $count ? '1 item' : number_format_i18n( $count ) . ' items'; }
